messages:
Priya S: HelioChip reached out for a joint perf/marketplace validation. Focus: perf/W, steady throughput, kernel-tune recommendations, and an SI compatibility checklist for their marketplace SKU. Two-phase run: dry-run + broad sweep, embargoed blog after legal review.
Miguel L: HelioChip eng here. We can provide 4 boards for dry-run and up to 12 for the sweep. Will share power telemetry, die temps, package power, and a HW spec sheet.
Tom K: Workloads: batched streaming chat, unbatched completion, and 768-dim embeddings. Seq targets: 128 / 512 / 1536. Test hot vs cold KV cache.
Priya S: Kernel flags to vary: attention_impl (naive|fused), block_size (64|128|256), packed_kv (0|1). Primary metrics: tokens/sec, avg_power_w, perf_per_w, p95_latency, sustained_10m_throughput. Secondary: fan_rpm, vram_voltage.
Ewa P: BenchBot policy: every run manifest must include model_commit, runtime_version, kernel_commit, dataset_seed, marketplace_sku, and embargo_until. Missing fields -> reject.
Aisha M: Marketing note  no public numbers until partner sign-off; need 1-paragraph blurb + partner quote. Request 7-day legal review window post-results.
Miguel L: Confirmed. HelioChip requires 7-day review. Also can we get an fp16 baseline and an int8-qat variant for parity checks?
Tom K: Yes. Draft run command (adjust sensors path as needed):
```bash
./bench_runner --model redwood-v2-base --seq 1536 --batch 4 --quant int8-qat --kernel-flags "attention=fused,block=128,packed_kv=1" --sensors /sys/helio/telemetry/power --run-tag helio-2026-sweep --manifest /runs/helio-1536.json
```
Miguel L: Change sensors path to /sys/helio/telemetry/power (ok). We'll pre-provision SSH + ephemeral S3 bucket for logs. Fan profiles available: normal|quiet|max. Run dry-run on normal and quiet.
Ewa P: BenchBot: dry-run job 39120 queued for 1767120000; will validate manifests and reject if metadata missing. Aggregation will inject kernel columns into CSV.
BenchBot: Scheduled job 39120 (dry-run) for 1767120000. Artifacts: s3://redwood-shared/helio/39120.
Tom K: Aggregation columns: run_id, model, seq_len, batch_size, quant, attention_impl, block_size, packed_kv, tokens_per_sec, avg_power_w, perf_per_w, p95_ms, peak_temp_c, fan_rpm, vram_v, manifest_hash.
Aisha M: For marketplace tile we need validated SKU name, recommended config, cost-per-token estimate, and a one-line SI compatibility note. Make marketplace_sku required in manifest.
Miguel L: We'll provide logos and a legal-approved quote after embargo. Can Redwood include a short compatibility matrix for common SI stacks to include in the marketplace tile?
Priya S: Product will produce compatibility table (docker images, runtime versions, kernel_commit). Tom owns technical appendix. Miguel will provide HelioChip sign-off.
Tom K: I'll include reproduction steps and fallback_policy (auto-retry with reduced batch/seq on OOM/thermal). Also include sha256 checks for model and dataset. BenchBot will block runs with mismatched checksums.
Miguel L: Dry-run availability Tue 09:30 PT. Posted board IDs and SSH fingerprints at https://helio-share/boards-2026.
BenchBot: Dry-run job 39120 started 1767120000. Live stream: https://benchstream/redwood/39120
Tom K: Monitoring dry-run. If green, schedule full sweep Wed-Thu next week and invite SI partners for Fri demo.
Aisha M: Marketing timeline: draft copy Wed evening, design Thu, legal review Fri. Publish earliest 7 days after results.
Priya S: I'll post the run matrix and invite stakeholders. Closing for now, will file minutes at https://redwood-internal/helio/bench-matrix. :calendar: :lock:
